heading: ## The re-sweep cadence and the six-case confidence statement (round 8, measured)

findings.skill_statement: the cadence is described as three readings per case, while the same section's tick defines exactly two readings per case ('Per case, two readings:' and a two-kind reading map: the target's relation to the branch-tip bytes, and the tool's relation to the last run). No place on the page defines a third per-case reading.
